metadata.scenario: A client is disputing a recent charge on their bill, claiming it is higher than what was agreed upon. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is David Anderson. I’m calling about a billing issue I have regarding my wife’s care. I’m sorry to hear that, David. Can you tell me more about the issue? Yes, I received the latest invoice, and it seems higher than what we agreed upon. I understand how important this is. Let me pull up your account. Can you hold for just a moment? Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience. I see that your wife has been receiving physical therapy and nursing care. The last invoice includes additional hours that were not initially scheduled. Additional hours? I wasn’t informed of any changes to her schedule. I apologize for any confusion, David. It looks like there were some extra sessions added due to her recovery progress. I appreciate the care, but I thought we agreed on a specific number of sessions. Let me review the care plan that was developed for her. One moment, please. Alright, thank you. According to our records, we had scheduled three sessions per week, but an additional session was added last week due to her condition. I can see how this might be unexpected. Yes, that’s definitely the case. I wish we had been notified about the extra session. I completely understand. I will make a note to improve our communication about schedule changes. That would be appreciated. What can we do about this billing discrepancy? I can arrange for a review of these charges. Would you like me to have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, follow up with you? Yes, please. That would be helpful. I’ll set that up. Would you also be interested in some additional nursing support for your wife’s recovery? We can help with medication management if that’s needed. Perhaps, but I need to resolve this billing issue first. Absolutely, I completely understand. Let’s focus on that first. Thank you, Margaret. When can I expect to hear back from Lisa? I’ll ensure she contacts you by the end of the day. Is that alright? That works for me. Thank you for your help. You’re welcome, David. Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Have a great day! You too, bye. Goodbye!
